title: Dsl Engine Support For Norm Iso 16757 And Vdi 3805
description: Build dsl:: engine support from scratch (including vcs::Operation/OperationDiff layer) for norm/iso/16757/rs (norm_iso_16757) and norm/vdi/3805/rs (norm_vdi_3805) — neither crate currently depends on vcs or dsl. Add #[derive(dsl::DslScalar)] enums, #[derive(dsl::DslRecord)] nested structs, #[derive(dsl::DslDocument)] on top-level Document, a coarse vcs::Operation/OperationDiff pair (SetDocument whole-value replace), #[derive(dsl::DslOps)] on the operation enum, DocumentVcsEnvelope/DocumentVcsStore aliases, extension constants iso16757/vdi3805. Use norm/core/rs/lib.rs as template. Add dsl/vcs deps to both Cargo.toml. Keep existing 39/40 tests passing, add DSL round-trip tests in existing mod tests.
summary: Built dsl:: engine support from scratch for norm_iso_16757 and norm_vdi_3805 — neither crate depended on vcs/dsl before. Added dsl+vcs deps to both Cargo.toml (../../../../dsl/rs, ../../../../vcs/rs). Applied #[derive(dsl::DslScalar)] to every reachable unit enum, #[derive(dsl::DslRecord)] to every reachable plain struct, #[derive(dsl::DslEnum)] to the recursive GeometryNode CSG tree (iso16757, exercising Box<T>/Vec<T> statements recursion as the stress test the task called for). Reused norm_core's existing generic SetDocumentOperation<D>/DocumentDiff<D>/OpText-for-D:DocumentDsl pair as the Operation layer (coarse SetDocument whole-value replace) rather than hand-deriving a redundant one-variant DslOps enum, since both crates already had `pub type Operation = SetDocumentOperation<Document>` — deriving DslDocument on Document was enough to make it fully DSL-text-capable for free. Added Iso16757Envelope/Store and Vdi3805Envelope/Store vcs::DocumentVcsEnvelope/DocumentVcsStore aliases plus ISO16757_EXTENSION/VDI3805_EXTENSION constants. Converted every Document-reachable HashMap<String,_> field to BTreeMap (no blanket HashMap DslField impl); left transient/non-persisted HashMap usages (BimEmbedding, ScriptRuntime, IfcCatalogueNode, resolve_bim_embedding params) untouched. Changed vdi3805's Document.edition_profile key from u16 to String (BTreeMap<String,_> is the only blanket map impl). Wrote hand dsl::DslField bridges (Shape::Text/UInt) for tuple-newtype ids that can't derive DslRecord (CatalogueId, RecordFamilyId, SheetId) and Shape::Value JSON bridges for CatalogueValue/VdiValue/PartNumberRule (each embedded as a BTreeMap value or bare enum field, which requires DslField, not just the DslVariants a DslEnum derive would give). Added a local VdiQuantityKind mirror enum (orphan-rule twin of foreign norm_core::QuantityKind, not yet dsl-converted) with From/Into conversions, used only at the VdiUnit.kind boundary. Found and fixed a real bug in my own JSON-bridge design: dsl::DslValue::Number is f64-only, so any Integer{value: i64} variant round-tripping through the Shape::Value bridge became a JSON float and failed strict serde i64 deserialization — fixed with a renormalize_whole_number_floats recursive JSON post-processor in both crates, verified with a direct regression test in iso16757 (fixture never exercised Integer) and via vdi3805's own reference fixture (which does use VdiValue::Integer). Added DSL round-trip tests (document_dsl_round_trip, op-text round-trip, full vcs-store document-text round-trip) to each crate's existing mod tests region, plus the integer-bridge regression test in iso16757. Verified with `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/private/tmp/claude-normisovdi-dslgreen-target cargo test -p norm_iso_16757 -p norm_vdi_3805`: norm_iso_16757 43/43 passed (39 original + 4 new), norm_vdi_3805 43/43 passed (40 original + 3 new). Zero pre-existing tests broken, zero new warnings in either crate.
